title: Role economics
description: Per-role spend record. Dollar figures are ESTIMATES ONLY — subscription-backed runs may have zero marginal dollar cost while consuming rate limits or weekly credits; calibration compares quality, latency, token pressure, and billing impact, never dollars alone.

actual.description: what actually ran (fallbacks make this differ from resolved)

fallback.description: why actual differs from resolved, when it does

estimated_cost_usd.description: estimate only; null when the billing mode makes dollars meaningless
